### Checklist

Please read `contributing.md` in this repository first.

- [ ] This pull request has a title like `Add Project Name`.
- [ ] The entry follows the format `- [Name](url) - Description.`
- [ ] The entry is at the bottom of the right category.
- [ ] The description is objective, starts with an uppercase letter and ends with a period.
- [ ] The project is related to Yggdrasil, has public source code, a license and documentation.
- [ ] The project had activity within the last 12 months and is not archived or deprecated.
- [ ] The project is not already on the list (including `archive.md`).
- [ ] The link works.
